source.qualification: No GPU row is rerun for this scope audit. SH9-D1 is mechanically prefill-only, SH7-A1 is the only post-SH6 retained decode change, and neither unit changes tracked or whole-GTT ownership. The audit therefore carries immutable measured rows and hashes rather than manufacturing duplicate benchmark activity.

hardware.system: Framework Desktop / AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395
hardware.canonical_decode_queue_scope: SH6 traces used queue 1/stream 0 despite an inherited two-queue cap; SH7 binding rows use the package-default one queue

scope_correction.sh9_decode_effect: none: rows==1 decode enters _run_post_attention_moe_c1 before the compact-WMMA multi-row helper
scope_correction.sh9_prefill_effect: pp512 has 4096 selected rows and 40 MoE-layer scalar reads per request; the retained package bound removes those 40 reads/dispatches
scope_correction.carry_rule: 512/4K decode and all four memory rows carry from SH6-C1; 32K/64K decode carries SH7-A1's retained one-queue candidate
scope_correction.no_duplicate_run_reason: The carried metrics are unaffected by SH9 and already satisfy exactness, lifecycle, trace, and measurement provenance requirements.

admitted.owner: private-c1 eager short-context full-attention context kernel
admitted.correction: Production c1 uses qwen35_paged_full_attn_decode_context_tensor_kernel, not context_tensor_batch_kernel<true,2>. The scalar route is fixed at 256 threads/16 q-head blocks and has no gfx1151 exact address-hoist or packed-load leaf; only an old 128-thread arithmetic-changing rejection exists.
admitted.gate: Cached actual-shape trace first, then only exact FMA/reduction-order-preserving leaf work with full state, lifecycle, 512 wall, prefill, and 1024-boundary guards.

admitted.correction: June G-D4 measured a material direct-path gain on gfx1100/Q4_K_S but changed the final token. Re-measure only as a default-off current gfx1151/Q4_K_M diagnostic; arithmetic drift remains a hard promotion blocker.

admitted.owner: private-c1 eager host synchronization and D2H boundaries
admitted.correction: Census decode independently of SH9. Do not infer 40 removed boundaries/token and do not reopen approximately 1% graph replay without the project-wide greater-than-3% dispatch-wall trigger.

Re-scope SH2-M2 as a phase-resolved precondition audit only because post-SH3 gaps are smaller. No lazy loader or dlclose work is admitted until peak phase and reclaimable subset exceed the actual gap.

admitted.gate: Recompute all four parity classes after SH10-SH13; do not stop after one leaf.

not_admitted.reason: Withdrawn by the follow-up review and consistent with the measured bandwidth floor plus SH-D1 tile8 rejection.

not_admitted.lead: SH3-M1 plus SH-K1 plus SH-M2 stacking rerun
not_admitted.reason: SH-K1 already fits but loses decode and raises candidate whole-GTT peak by 0.0703/0.1328 GiB at 32K/64K. Removing the embedding table shifts control and candidate equally; it does not convert a positive candidate-control peak delta into a saving.
SH9 changes prefill only and therefore removes no decode graph break. Existing graph evidence remains about 1%, below the declared host/C++ trigger.

not_admitted.lead: full-table mapped host embedding under raised memlock
not_admitted.reason: SH3-M1 already removes the complete 0.503-GiB device table for private c1. Raising a system limit may alter graph/embedding execution but is not an additional memory saving and requires a separate explicit human/system decision.

The review supplies no exact production seam or current actual-shape evidence beyond already screened value-vector and grouped-GQA families. Keep closed unless SH10/SH11 traces expose a new bounded owner.

decision: SH9-C1 is complete but the campaign objective is not. Start SH10-A1 on the actual short-context c1 attention kernel, then execute SH11-A1, SH12-C0, SH13-M1, and the cumulative SH14-C1 gate.
